entry.title: Updated: dsh-expert-mode
entry.summary: Expert-mode agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (v0.3.0, bilingual EN/ZH): a chief coordinator plus 11 domain-expert subagents with automatic task delegation. New: Three-Anchor constraint (recall/convergence/anti-drift per turn) and Near-distance Guidance (identity/task/output template per expert). Experts: data analyst, copywriter, legal review, product manager, frontend, UI/UX, architect, social media ops, growth hacker, quant finance, finance. Exact install spec: github:asher-2000/dsh-expert-mode. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: description, description_i18n.
